title: Settings
autonomy: Default autonomy level for new threads
autonomyHint: Autonomous execution within project scope; writes outside the project are still sandboxed and rollbackable.
toolDensityHint: Controls read/search tool group collapse: compact (always collapsed), balanced (collapsed, expandable), detailed (expanded).
notifHint: Control when system notifications are shown.
fontWeightHint: Adjust global font weight, effective immediately.

font.title: Font style
font.hint: Adjust the global font style and typography; serif, monospace, and other custom styles are supported.

uiDensityHint: Adjust global spacing, padding, and font size for the most comfortable reading and interaction experience.

reviewTabs.title: Right panel tab customization
reviewTabs.hint: Check to show or hide the corresponding tabs in the right review panel (ReviewPanel). At least one tab must stay visible.

wallpaperHint: Setting a wallpaper activates translucent frosted glass (similar to macOS vibrancy). Stored locally only.
glassMode: Enable frosted glass (uses default gradient when no wallpaper is set)
providerDesc: Manage model providers, API keys, and available models. The first configured provider automatically becomes the primary.
routingCardDesc: Route review, team, and council sub-agents to different models so they don't compete with the main session for cache.
mcpCardDesc: Connect external tool servers (such as Context7) to give the agent extended capabilities like documentation lookup.

permissionDirs.title: Directory Access
permissionDirs.desc: Codex-style standing grants: hand folders outside the workspace to the agent without per-operation approval prompts. A drive root (e.g. F:\ or /Volumes/Data) grants the whole drive. Only grant directories you trust the agent with.
permissionDirs.readDesc: The agent can read every file under these directories (no writes).
permissionDirs.writeDesc: The agent can read and modify every file under these directories. Write implies read.
permissionDirs.manualPlaceholder: or type an absolute directory path (~ supported)
permissionDirs.missing: Path does not exist (will be skipped)
permissionDirs.savedRestart: Saved · removed directories stay effective until the app restarts

computerUse.title: Computer Use
computerUse.desc: Let the agent see and operate desktop GUI apps (screenshot + accessibility tree + click/type). Each app's first action requires approval; apps you mark "always allow" are listed here.
computerUse.unavailable: Not supported on this platform (macOS and Windows only), or disabled via RIVET_COMPUTER_USE=0.
computerUse.proRequired: Computer Use is a Pro feature. Enable Pro in Settings → License to use it.
computerUse.grantsEmpty: No always-allowed apps yet. Check "always allow" on an approval card to add one.

about.eulaUnavailable: The EULA document is unavailable in this context.

runtimeDesc: Current sidecar version, session count, and running status.
updateDesc: Check for and install app updates. The app restarts automatically after the download to complete installation.
updateCheckFailed: Update check failed: {{error}} (if you just configured signing, make sure pubkey and endpoint are set)

autostart.title: Launch at login
autostart.desc: Start Tianshu automatically when you log in (Windows registry Run key / macOS LaunchAgent).

checkpoint.title: Auto checkpoints
checkpoint.invalidInterval: Turn count must be a non-negative integer (0 = off)
checkpoint.hint: In Auto mode, pause every N turns to sync a progress summary. Off by default (0 = never pause). Only applies in auto-safe mode; YOLO and Manual modes are unaffected. Switch permission mode via the Autonomy control above.

platform.title: Platform conventions (line endings / target OS)
platform.desc: Controls line endings for new files and the target OS reported to the model in the system prompt. auto follows this machine. Commands always run in the local shell — cross-platform overrides only affect file conventions, not command execution.
platform.saved: Saved · takes effect after restarting the app
platform.footer: .bat / .cmd always use CRLF; existing files always keep their original line endings. Per-project overrides go in the editor block of .rivet-config.json at the project root.

shell.title: Command execution shell (Git Bash path)
shell.desc: On Windows, Tianshu prefers Git's bundled Git Bash for command execution (more reliable POSIX behavior). If Git is installed in a non-default location or you want to pin a specific Git, enter the full path to bash.exe here. Leave empty for auto-detection (system Git → common locations → bundled PortableGit). The RIVET_GIT_BASH_PATH environment variable takes precedence.
shell.statusFallback: ⚠ Not using Git Bash — fell back to {{kind}}; some commands may misbehave or produce no output
shell.savedMissing: Saved, but the path does not currently exist — install Git or fix the path, then restart the app
shell.saved: Saved · takes effect after restarting the app
shell.cleared: Custom path cleared · auto-detection resumes after restarting the app

storageLocation.title: Storage location
storageLocation.desc: Set the Tianshu data root directory (RIVET_HOME). Changing it requires an app restart; you can optionally migrate existing data. Session logs, cache hit records, and configuration all live here.
storageLocation.savedRestart: Storage location saved, the app will restart now
storageLocation.openHint: Open the data root in your file manager to inspect session logs, cache records, and more.

storagePanel.intro: Choose where the Tianshu desktop app stores its data. Session logs, configuration, and project knowledge all live here. The first change requires an app restart to take effect.
storagePanel.customEmpty: Click the button on the right to choose a folder
storagePanel.migrate: Migrate existing data to the new location

storage.title: Storage management
storage.desc: Inspect session file usage and clean up archived sessions to free disk space. Deletion is irreversible; active sessions are unaffected.
storage.unavailable: Unable to read storage info (sidecar offline?)
storage.note: Archived session transcripts stay on disk indefinitely. The actions below only clean up archived sessions; active sessions are unaffected. Deletion is irreversible.
storage.cleanupConfirmDays: Clean up all archived sessions older than {{days}} days? This cannot be undone.
storage.cleanupConfirmAll: Clean up all {{n}} archived sessions? About {{bytes}} will be freed. This cannot be undone.
storage.deleteConfirm: Delete archived session "{{title}}" ({{bytes}})? This cannot be undone.
storage.openHint: Inspect session JSONL logs and cache records in your file manager.

help.startStep1: Add a model provider under "Integrations" and enter its API key (the first provider automatically becomes the primary model).
help.startStep2: Go to "Behavior" and choose the default autonomy level for new threads.
help.startStep3: Press <kbd>⌘N</kbd> to create a thread, describe your task, and Tianshu will code it autonomously.
help.startCta: Go to "Integrations" to set up a provider →
help.commandsLead1: Type <kbd>/</kbd> in the composer for command completion, or use the <kbd>⌘K</kbd> command palette. Commands with
help.commandsLead2: expect your task description after the command.

team.desc: Team mode: decompose the task → multiple patcher sub-agents work in parallel waves; the orchestrator handles integration, verification, and the final deliver_task. A plan file path also works.

teamMax.desc: Heavy formation: run dependency analysis / risk audit / adversarial blind-spot search before executing in parallel. Best for large changes / high-risk refactors.

council.desc: Council: adversarial consultation across star-domain experts — produces a plan only, no execution. Seats and debate rounds are configurable; each seat can be heterogeneous under "Integrations → Routing".

review.desc: L2 review: dispatch a single adversarial verification reviewer for the current uncommitted changes (deliver_task commit + L2).

reviewMax.desc: L3 review formation: 5 reviewers re-check in parallel (deliver_task commit + L3). Use it as the safety net before large changes or delivery.

plan.desc: Planning mode: read the code first, then produce an implementation plan with a Mermaid diagram + TDD steps (no implementation code), saved to docs/superpowers/plans/.

help.commandsHint: Heavy concurrent commands (/team / /review max / /council) dispatch sub-agents — configure "Sub-agent / review model routing" first, otherwise sub-agents compete with the orchestrator for the same cache-less provider and slow down the main conversation.
help.providerKeyDesc: Manage multiple providers (DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / Codex, etc.) under "Integrations → Model Provider". One of them is marked "primary" — the model used by the main conversation loop. Keys are stored locally only in ~/.rivet/config.json and never uploaded.
help.routingDesc1: Tianshu dispatches sub-agents for post-commit review and capability task delegation. If sub-agents share the same provider without server-side prefix cache (GLM / Kimi / Codex, etc.) with the primary, concurrent requests will evict the main session's server-side cache, making the main conversation suddenly slow or seemingly stuck.
help.routingDesc2: The fix: route sub-agents to a cheap "secondary model" (such as DeepSeek Flash). Cross-provider routing is supported — primary on GLM, sub-agents on DeepSeek Flash, with two independent caches. If the specified provider/model doesn't exist or lacks a key, it silently falls back to the primary model.
help.autonomyDesc: Set under "Behavior → Default autonomy level for new threads". Higher levels execute fully automatically inside the project directory; writes outside the project stay sandboxed, and every change can be rolled back.
help.filesNote: After editing the config by hand there's no need to restart the desktop app; it takes effect with the next new session. The loader only accepts JSON, with camelCase key names.
help.shortcutSlash: Use slash commands in the composer

providers.ctxPositive: Context window must be a positive integer
providers.maxPositive: Max tokens must be a positive integer
providers.maxExceedsCtx: Max output cannot exceed the context window (use the real limits from the official API docs)
providers.formHint: Use the real values from the provider's official API docs. The context window determines Tianshu's auto-compaction point (too small compacts too early and loses context; too large hits the API limit) and how much conversation the model can remember; max output tokens is the per-reply cap and cannot exceed the context window. DeepSeek V4 reference: context 1000000, max output 384000.
providers.deleteModelLast: This is the last model; deleting it removes the whole provider.
providers.cannotRemoveDefault: Cannot remove the default provider; switch the default first
providers.keyRequired: An API key is required to add a provider
providers.customCardSubtitle: Enter name, URL, and model manually
providers.name: Provider name
providers.allowProFallbackHint: Off by default. When enabled, falling back to this provider may use strong/pro models; Pro models can incur full-context cost on cache misses.
providers.loadFailed: Unable to load provider config (sidecar offline?)

profileHints.reviewer: Post-commit auto review / L3 formation review
profileHints.council_expert: Council seats (override takes precedence over task routing)

routing.intro: The main session and sub-agents can use different providers + models. Typical setup: a heavy model for the main session, a cheap fast Flash for review/chore sub-agents — this keeps cache-less providers like GLM/Kimi/Codex from evicting the main session's cache under concurrent sub-agent requests. The target provider must be configured under "Provider" with an API key, otherwise the entry silently falls back to the main session model.
routing.profileCardHint: Override by worker profile name; applies to every sub-agent carrying that profile — post-commit review, council seats (council_expert), and team formations (patcher / reviewer / scouts). Profile overrides take precedence over the task routing below, ideal for fine control like "strong model for the council, Flash for everything else".
routing.recommendTitle: Recommended: route common sub-agents to a cheap model
routing.recommendDesc: Review, verification, and coding sub-agents inherit the main session model by default and compete with the main conversation for cache. Apply once and these profiles will use the detected cheap model, keeping the main session stable.
routing.noCheapModel: No cheap / Flash model detected. Add a model like DeepSeek Flash under "Provider" first, then come back to configure sub-agent routing in one click.
routing.mechanicalFastPath: Skip review for docs-only / rename changes (mechanicalFastPath)
routing.taskCardHint: Each capability task points to a named profile (defined in workers.profiles, e.g. cheap-flash → DeepSeek Flash).
routing.councilCardHint1: Assign each council seat its own model for cross-model consultation like "Tianquan on DeepSeek Pro, Tianfu on GLM" — different models bring different perspectives, and each runs its own server-side cache without contention. Leave empty for the built-in default (tianquan / tianfu / tianxuan, all seats on the same model). Seat-level overrides take precedence over the council_expert profile override above.
routing.councilCardHint2: authority must be a star-domain id (10 built-ins in the input suggestions, or a loaded custom domain); a non-domain authority leaves the seat tool-less with no cognitive injection. Authorities must be unique per seat.
routing.noSeats: No custom seats configured — using the built-in default 3 seats.
routing.emptySeatWarn: Every seat needs an authority, otherwise the config cannot be saved.
routing.dupAuthorityWarn: Duplicate authority "{{authority}}" — each seat must be unique, or seats will be lost.
